meta.title: Bucket B provider-deployed Config custom rules
meta.boundary: These are provider-deployed AWS Config custom rules, NOT read-only collectors in this repository. Each checks that a provider-produced evidence artifact exists and is fresh within a review interval. A COMPLIANT result is telemetry (an artifact is present and current), never a compliance determination and never a source-eligibility or assessment decision. The provider owns the evidence S3 bucket and the review cadence. max_age_days values below are DEFAULT SUGGESTIONS the provider confirms against their own policy and the FedRAMP interval; they are not asserted as the FedRAMP-required values.

rules.evidence: training-records object covering each required audience
after-action report for each closed incident
incident response procedure and contact list, reviewed
incident history data store retention configuration record
scheduled log-review queries and alerting configuration record
vulnerability disclosure program document and intake config
